name: Echo
tagline: Builds the deck after a customer call, from what was actually said
description: After a discovery call or a demo it turns the call's own context into slides - what you heard, the next steps, the initiatives that came up - in Figma or Google Slides. It can fire automatically after every external call, or rewrite the deck live while you are still talking.

source.excerpt: Shared as a bot that turns a customer call into slides, during it or straight after.

body:
## What it does

After a discovery call or a demo it turns the call's own context into slides - what you heard, the next steps, the initiatives that came up - in Figma or Google Slides. It can fire automatically after every external call, or rewrite the deck live while you are still talking.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @kristaletz shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
